title: Riffelhorn/Riffelsee bounded official Swiss geodata acquisition
scope: Discovery, immutable source acquisition, metadata validation and 2-D inspection only; no rendering, terrain reconstruction or Lab 012B

aoi.rationale: Compact exact four-tile square retaining Riffelhorn faces, Riffelsee, alpine ground cover, loose rock, paths and southern glacier/moraine transitions. No Matterhorn expansion.

licence.access: Free official standard-product downloads without authentication
licence.infrastructure_conditions: Federal Spatial Data Infrastructure operating conditions and excessive-use restrictions apply
licence.label_interpretation: Preserved official catalogue label. Product reuse is governed by the linked custom OGD terms, not inferred from an SPDX/Creative Commons label. These are full product tiles, not test-only sample downloads.
licence.legal_uncertainty: No identified unresolved reuse/derivation/display restriction for these four standard products; retain attribution and applicable infrastructure conditions.

swissimage.generation: 2023, conventional DTM-orthorectified mosaic; not the true RGBN orthophoto generation beginning 2026
swissimage.sensor: ADS100, per generation specification; exact tile-specific serial/instrument metadata not supplied
swissimage.source_processing: Provider mosaic/radiometric processing and 25 cm to 10 cm resampling; JPEG is lossy. Not raw reflectance. No additional enhancement performed here.
swissimage.why_distributed_10cm: Only 0.1 m and 2 m assets exposed for selected items; finest official download retained unchanged. Native 25 cm file not exposed by this STAC item.
swissimage.accuracy: SWISSIMAGE Level 3 specification: nominal ±0.25 m horizontal, 1 sigma, for native 25 cm with swissALTI3D. Not independently assessed; steep faces can contain stretched pixels and shadows.
swissimage.exact_acquisition: 2023 map tile year for all four tiles; ≥70% year convention. 2023-09-07 SWISSIMAGE flight strip at 25 cm intersects AOI but pixel-to-strip assignment is unprovided. Other intersecting 2023 strips are cryosphere monitoring and not assumed mosaic sources.
swissimage.black_rgb_note: 267 all-zero distributed RGB pixels (2.67 m², 0.00006675% of AOI); vendor specification uses black for missing imagery but TIFF declares no NoData/mask hole. Dark imagery versus unflagged missing pixels unresolved; do not claim every pixel is observed.

swisssurface3d.sensor: Airborne LiDAR; exact instrument/serial/flight contractor not provided for these tiles
swisssurface3d.accuracy: Product claim ±0.20 m horizontal / ±0.10 m vertical, 1 sigma; not independently verified here
swisssurface3d.classification: Actual classes 1 unclassified, 2 ground, 3 vegetation, 6 buildings and 9 water. No class 17 in these four files. Provider ground includes boulders; classifications are not independent semantic truth.
swisssurface3d.precision: LAS coordinate quantization 0.01 m is not observation accuracy
swisssurface3d.crs_encoding: Actual LAS has no VLRs. Horizontal/vertical references derive from official product metadata and validated coordinate bounds.
swisssurface3d.coverage: No empty 100 m plan-area bins; not proof of gap-free fine sampling or complete cliff-face observations.

swisssurface3d_raster.derivation: Spike-free TIN of selected classified LiDAR plus synthetic water geometry from swissTLM3D. Interpolated DSM, not a raw-return height observation at each pixel.
swisssurface3d_raster.date: Three tiles 2021; northeast tile 2021/2022, confirmed map metadata
swisssurface3d_raster.accuracy: Product nominal ±0.20 m horizontal / ±0.10 m vertical, 1 sigma; interpolation, water handling, steep faces and classification are additional limitations.

swissalti3d.release: 2024, tile publication December 2024, consistent with official release 2024/2 Valais update
swissalti3d.source: Valais release note: replacement with 2021/2022 LiDAR, including above 2000 m, and photogrammetric change updates from 2023 aerial imagery
swissalti3d.interpolation: Linear interpolation of DTM-TLM/TIN; 0.5 m is distributed grid spacing, not independent measured density
swissalti3d.accuracy: 2024/2 release claim for new LiDAR-based terrain ±0.3 m, 1 sigma, in three dimensions; not independently verified and not interchangeable with surface-product accuracy
swissalti3d.unresolved: Cell-level provenance identifying which pixels were changed with 2023 imagery is not supplied.

spatial_validation.pixel_centres_note: Grids share edges; imagery centres are 0.05 m from tile edge, height centres 0.25 m. Not identical centres.
spatial_validation.point_cloud_note: Four complete tile footprints; populated 100 m bins do not establish gap-free 1 m sampling.
spatial_validation.vertical_note: LN02 (EPSG:5728), metres, established by official product metadata; not encoded in these TIFF horizontal CRS tags or LAS VLRs.

storage.policy: Originals/extractions/evidence/previews remain external. Git contains small provenance and offline tooling only.

temporal_compatibility.classification: Different-year imagery and LiDAR; mixed-acquisition northeast tile; composite terrain update product
implications: Snow/ice and moraines may have moved between 2021/2022 and 2023.
Water level, ground cover, infrastructure and paths can differ.
DSM−DTM may include update/classification/interpolation effects; not object-height truth.
Texture versus geometry discrepancies cannot be attributed solely to resolution.

terrain_inspection.method: North-up 1 m nearest-neighbour overview and three 150 m crops of original distributed imagery; elevation metadata extrema. No mesh, semantic classifier or new terrain grid.
confirmed_qualitatively: Exposed fractured bedrock and steep faces
Loose rock/scree-like deposits and large visible blocks
Paths, northern railway and limited infrastructure
terrain_inspection.limitations: Visual observations, not semantic labels or surveyed inventories. Deep shadows, orthophoto relief distortions and bright ice obscure some details.

toolchain.las_inspection: Narrowly gated LAS 1.2 formats 0–3 binary parser, chunked; no new dependency installed

next_experiment: Separately authorize one bounded mountain representation comparison using these sources, preserving native evidence and isolating temporally variable ice/water/shadows. No experiment implemented here.
uncertainties: Exact LiDAR instrument and flight contractor
Fine-scale point gaps/steep-face occlusions and independent registration accuracy
Temporal change on ice, water, paths and alpine ground cover

known_warnings: Existing bundle chunk-size and plugin timing warnings
